text: 近日，北京、上海、广东省广州市、湖北省武汉市陆续出台落实《关于完善商品住房销售制度的通知》的相关实施意见。新规带来哪些改变，如何提升购房者安全感？哪些新房能现房销售？北京、上海、广州、武汉都明确，以2026年8月28日作为时间分界点（住房城乡建设部、自然资源部、金融监管总局于8月28日联合印发了《关于完善商品住房销售制度的通知》），此后新发布土地出让公告的商品住房项目，优先现房销售。北京、上海两地明确要求，项目完成房屋首次登记——即项目竣工，获取“大产权证”后，才可以办理现房销售备案。武汉要求，房地产开发企业在办理不动产首次登记后，还应制定现房销售方案，
text_en: Recently, Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou in Guangdong Province, and Wuhan in Hubei Province have successively issued implementation opinions on the Notice on Improving the Commodity Housing Sales System. What changes do the new rules bring, and how do they enhance homebuyers' sense of security? Which new homes can be sold as completed properties? Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, and Wuhan have all made clear that August 28, 2026 will serve as the cutoff date (the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the Ministry of Natural Resources, and the National Financial Regulatory Administration jointly issued the Notice on Improving the Commodity Housing Sales System on August 28). For commodity housing projects for which land transfer announcements are newly issued after that date, completed-property sales will be given priority. Beijing and Shanghai have explicitly required that projects may only file for completed-property sales after completing the first registration of the property, that is, after project completion and obtaining the "major property ownership certificate."
